note: Both are multi-copy atomic and coincide on every standard litmus family over the common instruction set (verified against herd7's aarch64.cat and riscv.cat). The incomparability is instruction-level: RISC-V's fence.tso (which allows SB) and the RCsc/RCpc atomics differ from ARMv8's. See litmus/incomparable/ARMv8-vs-RVWMO.
